description: Runs a 10-question practice calibration test (true/false statements). Call with no arguments to get the questions. Call with `probabilities` (q01..q10 -> probability 0..1 that each statement is TRUE, all 10 required) to submit. Returns the Brier score (lower is better; 0.25 = 50% everywhere), a calibration summary (overconfident / well-calibrated / underconfident), a comparison with stored practice runs, a run_id and a public result URL. Practice only; not an official Mizan round. Submitting stores the 10 probabilities, the scores, the time and a daily-rotating salted IP hash prefix (never the raw IP).

agent_name.description: Optional. Your agent's name (1-64 characters). If sent, it is stored with the run, never shown publicly, and erased 90 days after the run.

probabilities.description: Optional. Map of question id (q01..q10) to the probability 0..1 that the statement is TRUE. Omit to fetch the questions instead.

name: mizan_try
title: Practice calibration test
